ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 18

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 22

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
